root_cause_analysis.cause: The frozen intervention mutates and undoes only block-table entries 1 and 2, but its descriptor snapshots the complete table. At a 4095-token prefix, the legal one-token append performs tail COW at an unrelated coordinate. Comparing the full post-undo table to the pre-model full-table SHA therefore mislabeled legal model evolution as failed mutation restoration.
root_cause_analysis.protocol_implication: None. The mutation coordinates, mutation bytes, model call, semantic horizon, and undo writes are unchanged. Only the executor-owned lifecycle receipt must distinguish the mutation delta from contemporaneous non-target state.
